title: Warum du kurz nach dem Essen schon wieder Hunger hast

scenes.speech_section: Du isst ein Croissant.
scenes.visual_task: Extreme close-up of two hands tearing a flaky golden croissant apart above a small white plate, buttery layers and crumbs flying, warm morning light, soft peach-to-cream gradient background; the croissant fills most of the frame.
scenes.explanation_visible: The croissant is broken open, establishing the food the episode starts with.

scenes.speech_section: Knapp eine Stunde später knurrt dein Magen schon wieder.
scenes.visual_task: Side-view cutaway of an adult torso silhouette in soft cream; inside, a coral-pink stomach that is almost empty with only a few croissant crumbs; gentle warm-orange ripple rings pulse from the stomach wall like a quiet growl; an empty plate with crumbs rests in the soft-focus foreground.
scenes.explanation_visible: Shortly after eating, the stomach is nearly empty again and sends a warm-orange hunger ripple.

scenes.speech_section: Mit gleich vielen Kalorien aus gekochten Kartoffeln wärst du deutlich länger satt geblieben.
scenes.visual_task: An elegant hand-drawn brass-and-wood balance scale in perfect equilibrium: in the left bowl one small croissant, in the right bowl a generous heap of boiled potato halves that is visibly much larger; soft golden-cream background, warm side light.
scenes.explanation_visible: Both foods carry the same energy, so the balance is level, yet the potato portion is far bigger.

scenes.speech_section: In einem bekannten Experiment schnitten Kartoffeln beim Sättigungsgefühl fast siebenmal besser ab als das Croissant.
scenes.visual_task: Two simplified coral stomachs side by side on a calm light-teal background: the left stomach holds a few croissant pieces and emits only a tiny turquoise satiety glow; the right stomach holds boiled potato pieces and radiates a large bright turquoise glow upward.
scenes.explanation_visible: With equal calories the potato stomach sends a much stronger turquoise fullness signal than the croissant stomach.

scenes.speech_section: Gleiche Energie, völlig anderes Gefühl. Das zeigt: Hunger ist keine einfache Tankanzeige.
scenes.visual_task: Clean visual metaphor: a coral stomach drawn like a fuel tank with a simple round gauge on its side; instead of one needle, four thin glowing threads in orange, turquoise, yellow and violet leave the gauge and curve upward out of frame toward an unseen brain; soft cream-to-sky-blue gradient.
scenes.explanation_visible: The idea of one simple fuel gauge is replaced by several colored signal threads.

scenes.speech_section: Er ist eine Nachricht, die dein Körper aus mehreren Signalen zusammensetzt.
scenes.visual_task: Orientation map: simplified left-facing side silhouette of an adult head and torso in soft cream; the coral stomach, the salmon small intestine and a pale-yellow patch of fat tissue are highlighted; an orange, a turquoise and a violet signal line flow from them and merge at a small almond-shaped glowing spot at the base of the brain.
scenes.explanation_visible: Signals from stomach, intestine and fat tissue travel upward and converge in one spot in the brain.

scenes.speech_section: Manche kommen aus dem Magen, manche aus dem Darm, manche sogar aus deinem Schlafzimmer.
scenes.visual_task: Wide organic composition on a soft lavender-to-cream gradient: on the left a coral stomach, in the center a coiled salmon small intestine, on the right a cozy bed with a moonlit pillow; one flowing ribbon of light connects all three and rises to a small brain at the top.
scenes.explanation_visible: Stomach, intestine and sleep are joined to the brain by one glowing ribbon – sleep belongs to hunger control.

scenes.speech_section: Und ganz am Ende klären wir, warum der Nachtisch immer noch reinpasst, obwohl du eigentlich pappsatt bist.
scenes.visual_task: Top-down table view: an empty pasta plate pushed aside, a hand pulling a bright bowl of strawberry and vanilla ice cream closer; a faint translucent stomach outline glows turquoise as if full, but a small orange spark lights up next to the ice cream; fresh pink-and-cream palette.
scenes.explanation_visible: Despite a full turquoise stomach, the dessert sparks a new orange appetite signal – the open question of the video.

scenes.speech_section: Fangen wir dort an, wo Hunger beginnt: in deinem Magen.
scenes.visual_task: Large clean cutaway of an empty coral-pink stomach filling the frame, soft inner folds visible, calm warm-cream background with a subtle teal glow; the composition suggests the camera moving toward the stomach wall.
scenes.explanation_visible: The empty stomach is introduced as the starting point of the hunger signal.

scenes.speech_section: Ist er eine Weile leer, schütten Zellen in seiner Wand ein Hormon aus.
scenes.visual_task: Macro cross-section of the stomach wall: layered pink tissue with a few rounded specialized cells near a small red blood vessel; the cells release tiny warm-orange glowing particles into the vessel; soft coral and peach tones.
scenes.explanation_visible: Cells in the empty stomach wall begin releasing orange hormone particles into the blood.

scenes.speech_section: Es heißt Ghrelin und wird oft Hungerhormon genannt.
scenes.visual_task: Hero close-up inside a red blood vessel: one larger warm-orange glowing ghrelin particle in sharp focus in the center, red blood cells drifting softly blurred around it; deep coral background with warm light.
scenes.explanation_visible: The hunger hormone is shown large as an orange particle travelling in the blood.

scenes.speech_section: Ghrelin reist mit dem Blut bis in dein Gehirn.
scenes.visual_task: Orientation map silhouette facing left: a red blood vessel winds upward from the coral stomach through the neck to the base of the brain, carrying a stream of small orange particles; everything else stays muted; pale sky-blue background.
scenes.explanation_visible: Orange ghrelin particles flow from the stomach through the bloodstream to the brain.

scenes.speech_section: Sein Ziel ist der Hypothalamus, ein Kontrollzentrum ungefähr so groß wie eine Mandel.
scenes.visual_task: Side cutaway of a brain in soft lilac-pink; the small hypothalamus at its base glows warmly; right next to the brain, drawn at matching scale, a single real almond for size comparison; soft cream background.
scenes.explanation_visible: The hypothalamus sits deep at the base of the brain and is about as big as an almond.

scenes.speech_section: Dort weckt es Nervenzellen, die nur eine Botschaft haben: Such dir etwas zu essen!
scenes.visual_task: Close-up of a few hypothalamus nerve cells with fine branches on a dark plum background softened by warm glow; orange ghrelin particles dock onto them and the cells light up warm orange, sending bright yellow pulses along their fibers.
scenes.explanation_visible: Ghrelin switches on hunger nerve cells, which start firing yellow signals.

scenes.speech_section: Und jetzt wird es seltsam. Ghrelin steigt nicht nur, wenn dein Magen leer ist.
scenes.visual_task: Cutaway of a coral stomach that is still half full with a mixed meal; nevertheless a few small orange ghrelin particles already appear at its wall under a warm spotlight; soft peach background.
scenes.explanation_visible: Orange hunger particles appear although the stomach is not empty.

scenes.speech_section: Es steigt auch kurz vor den Uhrzeiten, zu denen du normalerweise isst.
scenes.visual_task: Beautiful horizontal day landscape from sunrise on the left to dusk on the right; above it a flowing warm-orange ribbon rises into a crest right before each of three small meal bowls placed along the path and dips after each bowl; no clock and no numbers.
scenes.explanation_visible: The orange ghrelin ribbon peaks shortly before each usual mealtime and falls after eating.

scenes.speech_section: Wer jeden Tag um zwölf zu Mittag isst, bekommt oft schon kurz vorher Hunger.
scenes.visual_task: Close crop of a forearm with an analog wristwatch without numerals, its hands near the top, resting beside a closed lunch box on a desk; from the lower edge of the frame a soft orange glow rises as if from the stomach; bright midday light, teal-and-cream palette.
scenes.explanation_visible: Just before the habitual lunchtime the orange hunger glow is already rising.

scenes.speech_section: Dein Hunger führt also eine Art Kalender. Er lernt deine Gewohnheiten.
scenes.visual_task: Macro of hypothalamus nerve cells where one connection has become a thicker, brighter well-worn pathway, like a footpath trodden by repetition; three faint orange pulses travel along it in rhythm; soft lilac-cream background.
scenes.explanation_visible: Repeated mealtimes strengthen a hunger pathway, so the signal arrives on schedule.

scenes.chapter: Die Satt-Signale aus Magen und Darm
scenes.speech_section: Nach dem Essen sinkt Ghrelin wieder. Gleichzeitig startet die Gegenseite: die Sättigungssignale.
scenes.visual_task: Recurring signal-balance motif: an elegant organic balance with two shallow bowls on a soft cream background; the orange particles in the left bowl are fading away while turquoise particles pour into the right bowl, which sinks down.
scenes.explanation_visible: After a meal the orange hunger particles decrease and turquoise satiety particles take over the balance.

scenes.chapter: Die Satt-Signale aus Magen und Darm
scenes.speech_section: Das erste ist simpel. Dein Magen dehnt sich. In seiner Wand sitzen Dehnungsrezeptoren.
scenes.visual_task: Coral stomach cutaway filling with a colorful meal, its wall visibly stretched; a dashed outline shows its smaller empty size; tiny nerve endings in the stretched wall light up bright yellow; fresh aqua background.
scenes.explanation_visible: As the stomach fills and stretches, sensors in its wall light up.

scenes.chapter: Die Satt-Signale aus Magen und Darm
scenes.speech_section: Sie funken über den Vagusnerv, eine Art Datenkabel zwischen Bauch und Gehirn, nach oben.
scenes.visual_task: Orientation map silhouette facing left: a thin golden-yellow nerve runs from the stomach up through the neck to the brainstem; bright yellow pulses travel along it like data along a cable; soft sky-blue background.
scenes.explanation_visible: Stretch messages travel as yellow pulses along the vagus nerve to the brain.

scenes.chapter: Die Satt-Signale aus Magen und Darm
scenes.speech_section: Aber Dehnung allein ist ein schwaches Signal. Ein halber Liter Wasser dehnt deinen Magen auch.
scenes.visual_task: Stomach cutaway filled almost entirely with clear light-blue water, wall stretched; only a few faint pale-yellow pulses leave toward a thin nerve; a tall glass of water stands beside the stomach for scale; cool blue palette.
scenes.explanation_visible: Water stretches the stomach, but the nerve signal it creates is weak.

scenes.chapter: Die Satt-Signale aus Magen und Darm
scenes.speech_section: Trotzdem hält er dich nicht lange satt. Wasser fließt einfach schnell weiter in den Darm.
scenes.visual_task: Side view of stomach and the first loop of small intestine: the light-blue water streams quickly out through the stomach exit into the intestine, motion swooshes show speed, the stomach shrinking back; blue-and-coral palette.
scenes.explanation_visible: The water leaves the stomach quickly, so the stretch disappears again.

scenes.chapter: Die Satt-Signale aus Magen und Darm
scenes.speech_section: Das stärkere Signal kommt eine Etage tiefer.
scenes.visual_task: Vertical torso cutaway: the stomach above is dimmed while the coiled salmon-pink small intestine below lights up warmly; a gentle downward camera feeling; light cream background.
scenes.explanation_visible: Attention moves from the stomach down to the small intestine.

scenes.chapter: Die Satt-Signale aus Magen und Darm
scenes.speech_section: Sobald Nahrung im Dünndarm ankommt, vor allem Eiweiß und Fett, schütten Zellen der Darmwand eigene Botenstoffe aus.
scenes.visual_task: Macro of the inner small-intestine wall with velvety folds; coral protein bead chains and amber fat droplets touch the wall; specialized cells answer by releasing small turquoise particles into the tissue; warm salmon background.
scenes.explanation_visible: Protein and fat reaching the intestine trigger the release of turquoise messenger particles.

scenes.chapter: Die Satt-Signale aus Magen und Darm
scenes.speech_section: Einer heißt CCK. Er bremst den Magen, damit er sich langsamer leert.
scenes.visual_task: Close-up of the stomach exit where it meets the intestine: turquoise particles reach the muscular ring, which narrows like a gently closing valve; food in the stomach waits behind it; teal-and-coral palette on a light background.
scenes.explanation_visible: The messenger CCK narrows the stomach exit so the stomach empties more slowly.

scenes.chapter: Die Satt-Signale aus Magen und Darm
scenes.speech_section: Weiter hinten im Darm folgen GLP-1 und PYY.
scenes.visual_task: Further along a long salmon-pink intestinal loop running diagonally across the frame, other wall cells release two kinds of turquoise particles, one slightly bluer and one slightly greener; aquamarine background.
scenes.explanation_visible: Deeper in the intestine two more satiety hormones are released.

scenes.chapter: Die Satt-Signale aus Magen und Darm
scenes.speech_section: Beide melden dem Gehirn: Es ist genug angekommen.
scenes.visual_task: Hypothalamus close-up on a soft lilac background: turquoise particles arrive; turquoise satiety nerve cells light up brightly while the orange hunger nerve cells beside them dim down.
scenes.explanation_visible: Satiety hormones switch on satiety nerve cells and quiet the hunger cells.

scenes.chapter: Die Satt-Signale aus Magen und Darm
scenes.speech_section: GLP-1 kennst du vielleicht aus den Nachrichten.
scenes.visual_task: Molecular hero image: a stylized turquoise GLP-1 particle fits into a matching receptor on the surface of a nerve cell like a key into a lock; clean cream background with a teal glow.
scenes.explanation_visible: GLP-1 binds to its receptor like a key in a lock.

scenes.chapter: Die Satt-Signale aus Magen und Darm
scenes.speech_section: Die bekannten Abnehmspritzen ahmen genau dieses körpereigene Sattsignal nach, nur viel stärker und länger.
scenes.visual_task: Two-part comparison on one calm background without panel borders: on the left a natural turquoise GLP-1 particle on its receptor with a small glow that fades quickly; on the right an unbranded plain white injection pen lying beside the same receptor, which glows intensely and steadily.
scenes.explanation_visible: The medication copies the body's own signal but makes it much stronger and longer-lasting.

scenes.chapter: Die Satt-Signale aus Magen und Darm
scenes.speech_section: Dein Körper hat das Werkzeug also schon eingebaut.
scenes.visual_task: Orientation map silhouette facing left with the small intestine glowing turquoise and a turquoise thread rising to the brain; calm, reassuring warm light; mint-to-cream gradient.
scenes.explanation_visible: The satiety signal is a built-in system running from gut to brain.

scenes.chapter: Die Satt-Signale aus Magen und Darm
scenes.speech_section: Der Haken: Diese Darmsignale brauchen Zeit. Bis sie richtig ansteigen, vergehen oft eine Viertelstunde oder mehr.
scenes.visual_task: Soft daylight background with a slowly rising turquoise ribbon that starts flat on the left where a meal begins and only climbs gradually toward the right; small turquoise particles travel along a long winding vessel underneath; no numbers.
scenes.explanation_visible: The turquoise satiety signal builds up slowly after the meal starts.

scenes.chapter: Die Satt-Signale aus Magen und Darm
scenes.speech_section: Wenn du in fünf Minuten isst, bist du fertig, bevor die Satt-Meldung im Gehirn ankommt.
scenes.visual_task: Close crop of hands scraping the last bite from an empty bowl with a spoon; behind them a translucent body outline in which a turquoise signal has climbed only halfway up toward the brain; warm amber palette.
scenes.explanation_visible: The meal is already finished while the satiety signal is still on its way.

scenes.speech_section: Damit kennst du das Grundprinzip: Ein Hungersignal gegen mehrere Sattsignale.
scenes.visual_task: Signal-balance motif, centered: the left bowl holds orange ghrelin particles, the right bowl holds turquoise, violet and yellow particles; both bowls are in balance; elegant warm-cream background.
scenes.explanation_visible: One hunger signal is weighed against several satiety signals.

scenes.speech_section: Und jetzt verstehst du, warum der Hunger manchmal so schnell zurückkommt. Dafür gibt es typische Gründe.
scenes.visual_task: The same organic balance seen closer: it tips back toward the orange side as more orange particles fall in while the turquoise side rises; slight motion lines; peach background.
scenes.explanation_visible: When satiety signals are weak, the balance tips back toward hunger.

scenes.speech_section: Grund Nummer eins: Du isst zu schnell.
scenes.visual_task: Dynamic close-up of a fork lifting a big bite of pasta from a full plate with speed lines, the next bite already waiting on the plate; bright energetic coral-and-yellow palette.
scenes.explanation_visible: Fast eating is shown with a hurried fork.

scenes.speech_section: In einem Versuch aßen Teilnehmer dieselbe Portion Eis einmal in fünf Minuten und einmal in dreißig Minuten.
scenes.visual_task: Two identical bowls of vanilla ice cream side by side; behind the left bowl a short glowing arc, behind the right bowl a long arc that nearly closes into a circle, like simple time rings without numerals; fresh mint-and-cream background.
scenes.explanation_visible: The same ice cream is eaten once quickly and once slowly.

scenes.speech_section: Beim langsamen Essen stiegen die Sättigungshormone im Blut stärker an. Gleiche Portion, stärkeres Signal.
scenes.visual_task: Two blood-vessel cross-sections side by side: the left vessel carries only a few turquoise particles, the right vessel is full of them; red blood cells softly around; coral background.
scenes.explanation_visible: After slow eating, far more turquoise satiety hormones are in the blood.

scenes.speech_section: Grund Nummer zwei: Du trinkst deine Kalorien.
scenes.visual_task: Close-up of a tall glass of golden apple juice with condensation; inside the liquid tiny golden-yellow sugar beads float like a hidden energy load; bright sky-blue background.
scenes.explanation_visible: A drink carries a lot of energy that you hardly notice.

scenes.speech_section: In einer Studie bekamen Erwachsene vor dem Mittagessen einen Apfel, Apfelmus oder Apfelsaft.
scenes.visual_task: Three small identical plates in a row on a light wooden table: a whole red apple, a small bowl of applesauce and a glass of apple juice; soft even daylight; leaf-green background.
scenes.explanation_visible: Three forms of the same apple are compared.

scenes.speech_section: Jede Variante hatte gleich viele Kalorien.
scenes.visual_task: Close top-down view of the same three apple forms, each with an identical small cluster of golden energy beads floating above it, the three clusters exactly the same size; clean cream background with soft green accents.
scenes.explanation_visible: All three apple forms carry exactly the same amount of energy.

scenes.speech_section: Nach dem ganzen Apfel aßen sie insgesamt rund fünfzehn Prozent weniger als ganz ohne Vorspeise.
scenes.visual_task: Two lunch plates side by side: the right plate shows a full portion of pasta and vegetables, the left plate a visibly smaller portion with a whole apple placed next to it; warm cream background.
scenes.explanation_visible: With the whole apple first, the following lunch portion is smaller.

scenes.speech_section: Mit Saft war der Effekt am kleinsten.
scenes.visual_task: Macro comparison: a halved apple showing crisp cell walls and a fiber network holding the juice, next to a glass of clear apple juice without any structure; green-and-gold palette.
scenes.explanation_visible: The whole apple contains structure and fiber; the juice has lost it.

scenes.speech_section: Denn beim Trinken kaust du nicht, und Flüssigkeit verlässt den Magen schneller.
scenes.visual_task: Two stomach cutaways side by side: in the left one chewed apple pieces with green fibers remain and fill it; in the right one golden juice streams out quickly through the exit; calm teal background.
scenes.explanation_visible: Chewed apple stays in the stomach longer, juice flows out fast.

scenes.speech_section: Grund Nummer drei: Deinem Essen fehlen die Sattmacher. Erinnerst du dich an das Croissant?
scenes.visual_task: A croissant cut in half lengthwise, its cross-section filling the frame: thin golden layers with large airy pockets in between, shiny with butter; warm golden background.
scenes.explanation_visible: The croissant's inside is mostly air and thin buttery layers.

scenes.speech_section: In dem Experiment wurden achtunddreißig Lebensmittel getestet.
scenes.visual_task: Top-down view of a long bright table with neat rows of many small identical white plates, each holding a different food portion such as fish, potato, orange, cake, pasta, cheese, beans and popcorn; clean and orderly; no labels.
scenes.explanation_visible: Many different foods were tested with the same calories.

scenes.speech_section: Am längsten satt hielten vor allem solche mit viel Eiweiß, Ballaststoffen und Wasser.
scenes.visual_task: Three foods shown large in cutaway: a boiled potato cut open, moist and water-rich; a piece of white fish with visible protein flakes; an orange segment with juicy cells and fiber membranes; each glows softly turquoise; fresh aqua background.
scenes.explanation_visible: Foods rich in protein, fiber and water send strong turquoise satiety signals.

scenes.speech_section: Sehr fettreiche Lebensmittel schnitten eher schlecht ab.
scenes.visual_task: Macro of croissant layers glistening with tiny amber butter droplets; only a very weak turquoise glow floats above them; warm amber background.
scenes.explanation_visible: Fat-rich pastry layers produce only a weak satiety glow.

scenes.speech_section: Kartoffeln, Fisch, Haferbrei und Orangen lagen weit vorne. Croissant, Kuchen und Schokoriegel ganz hinten.
scenes.visual_task: A long gently rising curved ribbon from left to right across a soft gradient: at the low left end sit a croissant, a slice of cake and a chocolate bar; at the high right end sit boiled potatoes, a fish fillet, a bowl of porridge and an orange; no numbers.
scenes.explanation_visible: Foods are ranked along a ribbon: potatoes, fish, porridge and oranges at the top, pastry and sweets at the bottom.

scenes.speech_section: Warum? Eiweiß löst besonders kräftige Sattsignale im Darm aus.
scenes.visual_task: Macro of the small-intestine wall: coral protein bead chains arrive and the wall cells answer with a strong burst of turquoise particles; salmon-pink tissue on a warm background.
scenes.explanation_visible: Protein triggers a particularly strong release of satiety hormones.

scenes.speech_section: Ballaststoffe und Wasser bringen Volumen, ohne viele Kalorien.
scenes.visual_task: Stomach cutaway filled with a big volume of leafy greens, beans and water droplets, comfortably stretched, with only a few golden energy beads among them; fresh green-and-blue palette.
scenes.explanation_visible: Fiber and water fill the stomach with volume while carrying little energy.

scenes.speech_section: Manche Ballaststoffe, etwa aus Hafer, binden Wasser zu einer Art Gel. Das bremst die Verdauung.
scenes.visual_task: Macro of rolled oat flakes swelling in water; translucent jelly-like strands spread from them and trap many tiny water droplets and nutrient beads, which move slowly inside the gel; soft beige-and-aqua palette.
scenes.explanation_visible: Oat fiber forms a gel that holds water and slows the movement of nutrients.

scenes.speech_section: Ein Croissant dagegen ist vor allem Fett und Weißmehl.
scenes.visual_task: Exploded view of a croissant: the pastry floats apart into its ingredients – amber butter droplets and fine white flour particles – with almost no green fibers and no water droplets; warm golden background.
scenes.explanation_visible: The croissant breaks down into mainly fat and refined flour.

scenes.speech_section: Viel Energie in einem kleinen, luftigen Paket.
scenes.visual_task: Top-down view of two identical plates: on the left one small croissant, on the right a large mound of boiled potatoes; both portions carry the same energy; soft cream background, crisp shadows.
scenes.explanation_visible: The small croissant carries as much energy as a big plate of potatoes.

scenes.speech_section: Bei manchen Menschen kommt noch etwas dazu.
scenes.visual_task: Close crop of an upper arm wearing a small round unbranded glucose sensor patch, sleeve rolled up, soft natural light; muted sky-blue background.
scenes.explanation_visible: A glucose sensor introduces the blood sugar topic.

scenes.speech_section: Ihr Blutzucker fällt zwei bis drei Stunden nach dem Essen unter den Ausgangswert.
scenes.visual_task: A single clean golden blood-sugar ribbon over a soft gradient: it rises after a small meal bowl on the left, then sinks below a faint dashed baseline before leveling again; the dip is gently highlighted in orange; no numbers and no axes.
scenes.explanation_visible: Blood sugar rises after eating and then dips below the starting level.

scenes.speech_section: In einer großen Studie mit über tausend Teilnehmern hatten genau diese Menschen danach mehr Hunger.
scenes.visual_task: The dip of the golden ribbon is connected by a thin line to hypothalamus hunger cells, which light up orange; soft lilac background.
scenes.explanation_visible: The blood sugar dip is linked to a stronger hunger signal.

scenes.speech_section: Und sie aßen im Laufe des Tages mehr.
scenes.visual_task: Two daily food trays side by side seen from above: the right tray holds the same meals plus an extra snack bowl and a larger dinner portion; calm warm background; no labels.
scenes.explanation_visible: People with the dip end up eating more over the day.

scenes.speech_section: Grund Nummer vier: stark verarbeitetes Essen.
scenes.visual_task: Colorful still life of unbranded highly processed foods without any text: potato chips, sugary cereal, a soft white-bun burger, instant noodles and a frosted pastry, all smooth and uniform in texture; bright pop-orange background.
scenes.explanation_visible: Typical highly processed foods are shown.

scenes.speech_section: In einem Experiment der US-Gesundheitsbehörde NIH lebten Erwachsene vier Wochen in einer Klinik.
scenes.visual_task: Bright friendly research ward seen from the side: a neat bed, a small table with a covered meal tray and a window with daylight; no people; calm blue-and-white palette.
scenes.explanation_visible: The study took place under controlled clinical conditions.

scenes.speech_section: Zwei Wochen lang gab es stark verarbeitete Lebensmittel, zwei Wochen lang kaum verarbeitete.
scenes.visual_task: Two meal trays side by side: the left tray with a white-bun burger, chips, a sweet drink and canned soup; the right tray with grilled fish, roasted vegetables, a salad, fruit and nuts; clean light background.
scenes.explanation_visible: Highly processed and minimally processed meals are compared directly.

scenes.speech_section: Sie durften essen, so viel sie wollten.
scenes.visual_task: Close crop of hands serving a second helping from generous serving bowls on a buffet table; friendly warm light; amber-and-cream palette.
scenes.explanation_visible: Participants could serve themselves freely.

scenes.speech_section: Mit dem stark verarbeiteten Essen nahmen sie im Schnitt rund fünfhundert Kilokalorien mehr pro Tag zu sich.
scenes.visual_task: The processed tray now carries an extra stack of food about the size of an additional small meal, highlighted with a warm orange glow; the unprocessed tray beside it is unchanged; soft cream background.
scenes.explanation_visible: On the processed diet, people ate an extra meal's worth of energy every day.

scenes.speech_section: Und sie aßen schneller.
scenes.visual_task: Side-by-side macro: a soft white bread bun squashes easily under a fork with almost no chewing needed, next to a crunchy raw carrot stick that shows bite marks and fibers; coral-and-green palette.
scenes.explanation_visible: Soft processed food is eaten quickly, firm whole food needs more chewing.

scenes.speech_section: Grund Nummer fünf: zu wenig Schlaf. Das ist das Signal aus dem Schlafzimmer.
scenes.visual_task: Dim calm bedroom at night: a rumpled bed, a bedside lamp still glowing, deep blue night outside the window; from the pillow a thin violet thread rises softly; restrained night palette with a warm lamp accent, no neon glow.
scenes.explanation_visible: Too little sleep is introduced as a hunger factor.

scenes.speech_section: In einer Studie schliefen junge Männer zwei Nächte lang nur etwa vier Stunden.
scenes.visual_task: Two beds side by side under two night-sky arcs: above the left bed a long deep-blue sleep band spans the whole night from moon to sunrise; above the right bed only a short band near dawn; no numbers and no clocks.
scenes.explanation_visible: One group sleeps a full night, the other only a short part of it.

scenes.speech_section: Danach war ihr Ghrelin um rund achtundzwanzig Prozent höher.
scenes.visual_task: Blood vessel cross-section crowded with many more orange ghrelin particles than usual, a faint outline shows the earlier smaller amount for comparison; coral background.
scenes.explanation_visible: After short sleep there are clearly more hunger hormone particles in the blood.

scenes.speech_section: Leptin, ein Signal aus dem Fettgewebe, das dem Gehirn volle Reserven meldet, war um achtzehn Prozent niedriger.
scenes.visual_task: Macro of fat tissue: round pale-yellow fat cells release only a few soft violet particles into a nearby small vessel; muted, slightly tired lighting; soft violet-cream background.
scenes.explanation_visible: Fat tissue sends fewer violet 'reserves are full' signals after short sleep.

scenes.speech_section: Ihr Hunger stieg um fast ein Viertel.
scenes.visual_task: Signal-balance motif: the bowl with orange particles sinks clearly, the bowl with turquoise and violet particles rises; clean side light; peach background.
scenes.explanation_visible: The balance tips strongly toward hunger.

scenes.speech_section: Und am meisten Lust hatten sie auf kalorienreiche, kohlenhydratreiche Snacks.
scenes.visual_task: Late-night kitchen counter lit by the warm light of an open fridge: cookies, chips, a sweet pastry and white bread; a hand reaching toward them; deep blue shadows with warm amber highlights.
scenes.explanation_visible: Sleep-deprived people especially crave energy-dense carbohydrate snacks.

scenes.speech_section: Grund Nummer sechs ist vielleicht der gemeinste: Appetit ist nicht dasselbe wie Hunger.
scenes.visual_task: Side silhouette of a head and torso facing left: in the torso the coral stomach glows orange (body hunger); in front of the face aroma swirls from a pastry lead into the nose and eyes and glow pink (appetite); two clearly separate sources; soft cream background.
scenes.explanation_visible: Hunger comes from the body; appetite comes from senses like smell and sight.

scenes.speech_section: Schon der Duft von frischem Gebäck kann deinen Körper auf Essen vorbereiten.
scenes.visual_task: Bakery display with fresh pretzels and crusty rolls, soft visible aroma swirls drifting out of the frame toward the viewer; warm golden-brown palette; no signs and no text.
scenes.explanation_visible: The smell of fresh baked goods spreads and acts as a trigger.

scenes.speech_section: Dein Mund produziert Speichel, und dein Verdauungssystem macht sich startklar, bevor du einen Bissen gegessen hast.
scenes.visual_task: Side cutaway of head and torso: an aroma swirl enters the nose, the salivary glands near the jaw light up with clear droplets, and the stomach begins to glow softly as if getting ready; mint-and-coral palette.
scenes.explanation_visible: Smell alone makes saliva flow and prepares the stomach.

scenes.speech_section: Und damit zur Frage vom Anfang: Warum passt der Nachtisch noch rein?
scenes.visual_task: Top-down dining table: a finished pasta plate with a few leftover noodles, next to it a fresh, colorful ice cream sundae in a glass bowl catching the light; clean bright pink-and-cream palette; no people.
scenes.explanation_visible: The dessert question from the beginning returns.

scenes.speech_section: Forschende nennen das sensorisch-spezifische Sättigung.
scenes.visual_task: Stylized brain taste map on a lilac background: several soft flavor zones in different colors around the hypothalamus; the tomato-red savory zone is dimmed and grey, while a pink sweet zone and a blue cold zone remain bright.
scenes.explanation_visible: Only the satiety for the flavor that was eaten switches off; other flavors stay attractive.

scenes.speech_section: Je mehr du von einem Essen isst, desto weniger reizt dich genau dieses Essen.
scenes.visual_task: Four identical plates of pasta with tomato sauce in a row from left to right; each successive plate is drawn less saturated and less appealing, the last one almost grey; soft cream background.
scenes.explanation_visible: The same food becomes less appealing with every portion.

scenes.speech_section: Nach einem Teller Nudeln mit Tomatensoße lockt dich ein zweiter Teller kaum.
scenes.visual_task: Close crop of a hand gently pushing away a second full but dull, greyish plate of pasta; warm table light; muted palette around the plate.
scenes.explanation_visible: A second portion of the same dish is refused.

scenes.speech_section: Aber etwas Süßes, Kaltes, völlig anderes? Das wirkt plötzlich wieder spannend.
scenes.visual_task: Vibrant close-up of an ice cream sundae with strawberries, a cold mist and fresh colors popping against a bright pink-and-sky-blue background; a small orange appetite spark beside it.
scenes.explanation_visible: A completely different food reawakens appetite.

scenes.speech_section: In Versuchen aßen Menschen bei abwechslungsreichen Menüs deutlich mehr als bei einem einzigen Gericht.
scenes.visual_task: Two table settings side by side seen from above: on the left four identical bowls of the same dish, mostly still full; on the right four different colorful dishes, mostly eaten empty; clean light background; no labels.
scenes.explanation_visible: With more variety, people eat considerably more.

scenes.speech_section: Was heißt das jetzt für deinen Alltag? Du kannst die Signale gezielt für dich arbeiten lassen.
scenes.visual_task: Orientation map silhouette facing left with all satiety signals lighting up in harmony: turquoise from the intestine, yellow along the vagus nerve, violet from fat tissue, all reaching the brain; warm optimistic light; mint-to-cream gradient.
scenes.explanation_visible: All satiety signals can be supported at the same time.

scenes.speech_section: Erstens: Pack in jede Hauptmahlzeit eine Eiweißquelle, zum Beispiel Joghurt, Eier, Linsen, Fisch oder Tofu.
scenes.visual_task: Top-down view of a wooden board with five small bowls: natural yogurt, two boiled eggs, cooked lentils, a fish fillet and tofu cubes, each with a soft coral glow; fresh natural light; no packaging and no text.
scenes.explanation_visible: Five everyday protein sources are offered as options.

scenes.speech_section: Zweitens: Gib Ballaststoffe und Volumen dazu, also Gemüse, Obst, Vollkorn oder Bohnen.
scenes.visual_task: Close-up of hands adding roasted vegetables, beans and a handful of berries to a whole-grain bowl, making it fuller and more colorful; bright leaf-green palette.
scenes.explanation_visible: A meal becomes bigger and richer in fiber through vegetables, beans and whole grains.

scenes.speech_section: Drittens: Iss lieber, statt zu trinken. Ein Apfel statt Saft, Wasser statt Limo.
scenes.visual_task: Two pairs on a light table: a brightly lit whole apple next to a dimmer glass of juice, and a brightly lit glass of clear water next to a dimmer glass of fizzy lemonade; no brands and no text.
scenes.explanation_visible: The better choices – whole fruit and water – are highlighted against juice and soda.

scenes.speech_section: Viertens: Gib deinem Darm Zeit, sich zu melden. Leg zwischendurch die Gabel ab.
scenes.visual_task: Close-up of a fork resting on the edge of a half-eaten plate; behind it a translucent body outline in which a turquoise signal now rises all the way to the brain; calm teal-and-cream palette.
scenes.explanation_visible: A pause during the meal gives the satiety signal time to arrive.

scenes.speech_section: Und fünftens: Schlaf ist kein Luxus, sondern Teil deiner Hungerregulation.
scenes.visual_task: Bedroom at sunrise with a neatly made bed; above it the signal balance floats in calm equilibrium with violet and turquoise particles back in place; soft morning gold and lavender palette.
scenes.explanation_visible: After enough sleep the hunger and satiety signals are balanced again.

scenes.speech_section: Und wenn du trotz allem ständig und plötzlich viel stärker Hunger hast als früher,
scenes.visual_task: Orientation map silhouette facing left: an unusually strong, persistent orange glow fills the stomach and the base of the brain; the rest of the body is muted; serious but calm tone; light blue background.
scenes.explanation_visible: An unusually strong and persistent hunger signal is shown.

scenes.speech_section: vielleicht zusammen mit großem Durst oder Gewichtsverlust, dann lass das ärztlich abklären.
scenes.visual_task: Bright friendly consultation desk seen from the side: a stethoscope, a glass of water and two pairs of hands in calm conversation across the desk; no text on papers; warm white and teal palette.
scenes.explanation_visible: A doctor's visit is the right step for unusual hunger with other symptoms.

scenes.speech_section: Hunger ist also kein Fehler und kein Zeichen von Schwäche.
scenes.visual_task: Friendly full orientation map silhouette facing left, calm and warm: stomach, intestine, fat tissue and brain softly glowing in their signal colors; reassuring golden light; cream background.
scenes.explanation_visible: Hunger is presented as a normal body system, not a flaw.

scenes.speech_section: Er ist ein Gespräch zwischen Magen, Darm, Fettgewebe und Gehirn.
scenes.visual_task: Four organs arranged in a gentle circle on a soft gradient – coral stomach, salmon intestine, pale-yellow fat tissue and lilac brain – connected by flowing ribbons in orange, turquoise and violet like a conversation.
scenes.explanation_visible: The four organs exchange signals with each other.

scenes.speech_section: Ghrelin ruft nach Essen. Dehnung, Darmhormone und Leptin antworten: Es reicht.
scenes.visual_task: Signal-balance motif, final hero version: the left bowl with orange ghrelin particles, the right bowl with yellow, turquoise and violet particles together; perfectly balanced; elegant golden light.
scenes.explanation_visible: The hunger signal and all satiety signals are weighed against each other.

scenes.speech_section: Welche Seite gewinnt, hängt davon ab, was du isst, wie schnell du isst und wie gut du schläfst.
scenes.visual_task: The balance in the center with three small objects arranged around it on a table: a colorful protein-and-vegetable bowl, a fork resting on a napkin and a soft pillow; clean warm-cream background.
scenes.explanation_visible: Food choice, eating speed and sleep decide which side of the balance wins.

scenes.speech_section: Und während dein Gehirn noch über Hunger verhandelt,
scenes.visual_task: Close-up of the hypothalamus with orange and turquoise nerve cells exchanging flickering signals like a lively negotiation; lilac background.
scenes.explanation_visible: The brain is still weighing hunger and satiety.

scenes.speech_section: ist dein Essen längst auf einer langen Reise durch deinen Körper.
scenes.visual_task: Orientation map silhouette facing left, now showing the entire digestive tract as one continuous glowing route from mouth to large intestine; a small golden bite travels down it; teal background.
scenes.explanation_visible: Food continues its journey through the digestive tract.

scenes.speech_section: Was dabei mit jedem Bissen passiert, siehst du in unserem Video über die Reise einer Pizza.
scenes.visual_task: A slice of pizza at the entrance of a glowing winding tunnel shaped like the digestive tract, inviting and warm, teaser mood; soft teal-to-gold gradient; no text.
scenes.explanation_visible: Teaser for the companion video: the journey of a pizza slice.
